Q: On Android, why does the system tell me that my app is much larger than of the uncompressed APK? A:

So in the Device Explorer, I found the APK (7MB) but also an extracted 3rd party library that I am using: 5.1MB.

If I assume that all the contents of the APK have been extracted to some hidden place, then: 12.4MB + 7MB + 5.1MB = 24.5MB, which is very close to what is claimed.

Q: Docker Compose - How to execute multiple commands? A:

Not always the case but you can usepost_start that defines a sequence of lifecycle hooks that run after a container has started.

Clean and simple:

post_start:
      - command: ["chown", "-R", "appuser:appuser", "/srv/app/media/upload/books"]
        user: root
      - command: sh -c 'python3 -m home_page_books.create_home_page_books'

Q: What is the different of <div> and <span> display : block; A:

You can indeed force a <span> to behave like a <div> by applying some styling, but the W3C validator may still report that what you are doing is wrong. There are rules for which html tags are allowed inside others, and the presence of styling does not change any of those rules.

E.g. this snippet is valid:

<div><p>Hello</p></div>

But this snippet will cause a validation error:

<span><p>Hello</p></span>

The reason is that p is a valid child of div, but not of span. Bending the rules like you propose may cause people or systems (e.g. a screen reader, a search engine) to misunderstand your page.

Q: Best way to drop/create a replicated table A:

I added this in case someone needs a solution that does not require removing subscribers and does not require a full snapshot per publication. Here is a script that I cobbled together that can be applied pre/post deployment. It will only re-snap the tables that have been added or removed and added back.

Usage

Make two copies of the script. One copy runs prior to all other deployment scripts and the second copy runs after all other deployment scripts have been applied.

Ex.

0000-this-script-pre-deployment.sql
001-deployment-script1.sql 
002-deployment-script1.sql
003-deployment-script1.sql
0000-this-script-post-deployment.sql

In the first script set the

@BeforeOrAfterDeploy = 'BEFORE'

In the last script set

@BeforeOrAfterDeploy = 'AFTER'

Rename a Table

INSERT INTO @TablesRemove VALUES('tblOldName')
INSERT INTO @TablesToAddOrAddBack VALUES('tblNewName')

Truncate a table

INSERT INTO @TablesRemove VALUES('tblTruncate')
INSERT INTO @TablesToAddOrAddBack VALUES('tblTruncate')

To remove a table

INSERT INTO @TablesRemove VALUES('tblRemoveTable')

To rename a column (note adding and removing columns does require action, those commands are handled as a non-breaking DDL changes):

INSERT INTO @TablesRemove VALUES('tblRenameColumn')
INSERT INTO @TablesToAddOrAddBack VALUES('tblRenameColumn')

To add a new table

INSERT INTO @TablesToAddOrAddBack VALUES('tblNewTable')

Script

SET NOCOUNT ON
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED

DECLARE @BeforeOrAfterDeploy NVARCHAR(20) = 'BEFORE' --BEFORE OR AFTER

DECLARE @TablesRemove TABLE(TableName NVARCHAR(300))
DECLARE @TablesToAddOrAddBack TABLE(TableName NVARCHAR(300))


INSERT INTO @TablesRemove VALUES
('tblActivityObject')

INSERT INTO @TablesToAddOrAddBack VALUES
('tblActivityObject')


----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

DECLARE @DBG BIT = 0

IF NOT(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @TablesRemove) OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @TablesToAddOrAddBack)) 
BEGIN
    IF (@DBG=1) PRINT 'Nothing to do...'
    RETURN
END
IF (NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND  TABLE_NAME = 'sysarticles'))
BEGIN
    IF (@DBG=1) PRINT 'Database not in replication'
    RETURN
END

DECLARE @ArticleName NVARCHAR(300), @TableName NVARCHAR(300), @PublicationName NVARCHAR(300), @SubscriptionServer NVARCHAR(300), @SubscriptionDatabase NVARCHAR(300)
DECLARE @Exceptions TABLE(ExceptionMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)) 
DECLARE @PublicationArticles TABLE(TableName NVARCHAR(300), ArticleName NVARCHAR(300),PublicationName NVARCHAR(300), SubscriptionServer NVARCHAR(300), SubscriptionDatabase NVARCHAR(100)) 
DECLARE @Publications TABLE(PublicationName NVARCHAR(300), SubscriptionServer NVARCHAR(300)) 

--Theoretically, there could be multiple subs for each pub and a table coould appear in multiple one or more pubs. This handles all cases
INSERT @PublicationArticles
SELECT      
    CASE WHEN s.login_name = 'aws_dms_user' THEN a.dest_table ELSE a.[name] END AS TableName,
    --AWS Mangles the articlename, we display tablename to the user but use the articlename in the drop procs
    a.[name] AS ArticleName,
    p.[name] AS PublicationName,
    UPPER(srv.srvname) AS SubscriptionServer,
    s.dest_db AS SubscriptionDatabase
FROM 
    dbo.syspublications p  
    JOIN dbo.sysarticles a on p.pubid = a.pubid 
    LEFT JOIN dbo.syssubscriptions s on a.artid = s.artid 
    LEFT JOIN master.dbo.sysservers srv on s.srvid = srv.srvid  
    INNER JOIN @TablesRemove TR ON TR.TableName = a.[name] OR TR.TableName = a.dest_table

INSERT @Publications
SELECT DISTINCT 
    p.[name] AS PublicationName,
    UPPER(srv.srvname) AS SubscriptionServer
FROM 
    dbo.syspublications p  
    JOIN dbo.sysarticles a on p.pubid = a.pubid 
    JOIN dbo.syssubscriptions s on a.artid = s.artid 
    LEFT JOIN master.dbo.sysservers srv on s.srvid = srv.srvid



IF(@BeforeOrAfterDeploy = 'BEFORE')
BEGIN

    

    DECLARE RemoveTableLoop CURSOR FOR 
    SELECT ArticleName, TableName, PublicationName, SubscriptionServer, SubscriptionDatabase  
    FROM @PublicationArticles
    WHERE
        (PublicationName LIKE '%_PUB' AND NOT SubscriptionServer IS NULL) --on-prem and make sure we only pick up one when there are dups based on replications "virtual" placeholders created when immediate-sync is toggled
        OR
        (PublicationName LIKE '%_PUBLICATION_%') --Aws

    OPEN RemoveTableLoop
    FETCH NEXT FROM RemoveTableLoop INTO @ArticleName, @TableName, @PublicationName, @SubscriptionServer, @SubscriptionDatabase
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
    
        BEGIN TRY
            IF (@DBG=1) PRINT  'Dropping Article '+@TableName+':'+ISNULL(@ArticleName,'')+'  from '+@PublicationName
            --If the subscription server is not null, it means we have a subscriber and first we need to remove the article from that subscription  
            IF(NOT @SubscriptionServer IS NULL) 
                EXECUTE sp_dropsubscription @publication = @PublicationName, @article = @ArticleName, @subscriber =  @SubscriptionServer, @destination_db  = @SubscriptionDatabase                          
            --Now Remove the article from the local subscription if it was successfully removed from all subscriptions      
            EXECUTE sp_droparticle @publication = @PublicationName, @article = @ArticleName, @force_invalidate_snapshot=1
         
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            INSERT INTO @Exceptions VALUES(@TableName+' : DROP ARTICLE FROM '+DB_NAME()+'.'+@PublicationName+' EXCEPTION : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE())
        END CATCH

        FETCH NEXT FROM RemoveTableLoop INTO @ArticleName, @TableName, @PublicationName, @SubscriptionServer, @SubscriptionDatabase
    END
    CLOSE RemoveTableLoop
    DEALLOCATE RemoveTableLoop

END ELSE BEGIN -- AFTER DEPLOY

    DECLARE PublicationLoop CURSOR FOR SELECT DISTINCT PublicationName FROM @Publications   
    
    OPEN PublicationLoop
    FETCH NEXT FROM PublicationLoop INTO @PublicationName
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
    
        DECLARE AddTableLoop CURSOR FOR SELECT TableName FROM @TablesToAddOrAddBack
        OPEN AddTableLoop
        FETCH NEXT FROM AddTableLoop INTO @TableName
        WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
        
            BEGIN TRY
                IF (@DBG=1) PRINT 'Adding Article '+@TableName+' to '+@PublicationName

                DECLARE @InsertCommand NVARCHAR(300) = 'CALL sp_MSins_dbo_'+@TableName
                DECLARE @DeleteCommand NVARCHAR(300) = 'CALL sp_MSdel_dbo_'+@TableName
                DECLARE @UpdateCommand NVARCHAR(300) = 'CALL sp_MSupd_dbo_'+@TableName
            
                exec sp_addarticle 
                        @publication = @PublicationName, 
                        @article = @TableName, 
                        @source_owner = 'dbo', 
                        @source_object = @TableName, 
                        @type = 'logbased', 
                        @description = null, 
                        @creation_script = null, 
                        @pre_creation_cmd = 'truncate',---!!!! Keep indexes             
                        --NO NCI @schema_option = 0x000000000803509F,                                            
                        @schema_option = 0x00000000080350DF,
                        @identityrangemanagementoption = 'manual', 
                        @destination_table = @TableName, 
                        @destination_owner = 'dbo', 
                        @vertical_partition = 'false', 
                        @ins_cmd = @InsertCommand, 
                        @del_cmd = @DeleteCommand, 
                        @upd_cmd = @UpdateCommand
                
            END TRY
            BEGIN CATCH     
                INSERT INTO @Exceptions VALUES(@TableName+' : ADD TABLE TO PUB '+DB_NAME()+'.'+@PublicationName+' EXCEPTION : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE())
            END CATCH

            FETCH NEXT FROM AddTableLoop INTO @TableName
        END
        CLOSE AddTableLoop
        DEALLOCATE AddTableLoop
        
        FETCH NEXT FROM PublicationLoop INTO @PublicationName
    END
    CLOSE PublicationLoop
    DEALLOCATE PublicationLoop

    DECLARE ResnapTablesLoop CURSOR FOR
    --Only pubs that have at least one subscriber
    SELECT DISTINCT PublicationName FROM @Publications WHERE NOT SubscriptionServer IS NULL

    OPEN ResnapTablesLoop
    FETCH NEXT FROM ResnapTablesLoop INTO @PublicationName
    WHILE (@@FETCH_STATUS = 0) BEGIN
        BEGIN TRY       

            IF (@DBG=1) PRINT 'Re-snapping added tables for '+@PublicationName

            --This will force a snapshot with just the new article
            EXEC sp_changepublication @publication = @PublicationName, @property = 'allow_anonymous', @value = 'false' 
            EXEC sp_changepublication @publication = @PublicationName, @property = 'immediate_sync', @value = 'false' 

            --Resnap the tables, only the tables we just added back will be affected.
            exec sp_refreshsubscriptions @publication = @PublicationName        
            exec sp_startpublication_snapshot @publication = @PublicationName
            
        END TRY
        BEGIN CATCH
            INSERT INTO @Exceptions VALUES('Could not Re-Snap Tables For PUB '+DB_NAME()+'.'+@PublicationName+' EXCEPTION : '+ ERROR_MESSAGE())
        END CATCH
        FETCH NEXT FROM ResnapTablesLoop INTO @PublicationName
    END
    CLOSE ResnapTablesLoop
    DEALLOCATE ResnapTablesLoop
END

IF(EXISTS(SELECT * FROM @Exceptions)) BEGIN
    DECLARE @ExceptionMessage NVARCHAR(MAX)
    SELECT @ExceptionMessage = STRING_AGG(ExceptionMessage,',') FROM @Exceptions
    PRINT @ExceptionMessage
    RAISERROR('REPLICATION OPERATION ERROR OCCURRED',16,1)  
END
